## Dimensionality reduction remove unwanted channels
```{r}
library(matrixStats)
expr_mat <- assay(spe, "exprs")
marker_variance <- rowVars(expr_mat)
top_markers <- order(marker_variance, decreasing = TRUE)[20:38]  # Try top 20
rownames(spe)[top_markers]
```

```{r}
rowData(spe)$use_channel <- !grepl("DNA|ICSK|PDL1|PD1|CD45RO|CD45RA|CD14|CD19|CD25|CXCR3|CCR4|IgM|Ki-67|CLA|CD56", rownames(spe))
```

# fastMNN correction
```{r}
print(paste("Start time fastMNN correction:", Sys.time()))

set.seed(220228)

parallel_params <- MulticoreParam(workers = 14, log = TRUE, progressbar = TRUE)
register(parallel_params)

out <- fastMNN(spe,
               batch = spe$patient_id,
               auto.merge = TRUE,
               subset.row = rowData(spe)$use_channel,
               assay.type = "exprs",
#               k = 18,
               BPPARAM = parallel_params,
               BSPARAM = BiocSingular::ExactParam())

reducedDim(spe, "fastMNN") <- reducedDim(out, "corrected")

set.seed(220228)
spe <- runUMAP(spe, dimred= "fastMNN", name = "UMAP_mnnCorrected")

print(paste("End time fastMNN correction:", Sys.time()))
```

#visualize single-cell metadata
```{r,fig.height=10, fig.width=20}
dittoDimPlot(spe, var = "patient_id", reduction.use = "UMAP_mnnCorrected", size = 0.2) + scale_color_manual(values = metadata(spe)$color_vectors$patient_id) +ggtitle("UMAP Corrected")
```

## fastMNN
```{r,fig.height=10, fig.width=20}
set.seed(220621)
clusters <- clusterCells(spe,
                         use.dimred = "fastMNN",
                         BLUSPARAM = SNNGraphParam(k = 29,
                                        cluster.fun = "louvain",
                                        type = "rank"))

spe$nn_clusters_corrected_fastMNN <- clusters

dittoDimPlot(spe, var = "nn_clusters_corrected_fastMNN",
             reduction.use = "UMAP_mnnCorrected", size = 0.2,
             do.label = TRUE) +
    ggtitle("SNN clusters on UMAP_mnnCorrected, integrated cells")
```


```{r,fig.height=10, fig.width=18}

rowData(spe)$use_channel2= rowData(spe)$use_channel2=rowData(spe)$use_channel2 <- !grepl("DNA|ICSK|PDL1|PD1|CD45RO|CD25|CXCR3|CCR4|E-Cadherin", rownames(spe))


cluster_mean <- aggregateAcrossCells(as(spe, "SingleCellExperiment"), ids = spe$nn_clusters_corrected_fastMNN, statistics = "mean", use.assay.type = "exprs")

# Z score scaled
dittoHeatmap(cluster_mean, genes = rownames(spe)[rowData(spe)$use_channel2],
             assay = "exprs",
             show_colnames = TRUE,
             cluster_cols = FALSE,
             cluster_rows = TRUE,  display_numbers = TRUE,
             annot.by = c("nn_clusters_corrected_fastMNN")
             )
```

# assign cell-type

#assign cell types to clusters
```{r}

cluster_celltype <- recode(spe$nn_clusters_corrected_fastMNN,
                           "1"  = "Macrophages",
                           "2"  = "Helper/Regulatory T-cells",
                           "3"  = "Cytotoxic T-cells",
                           "4"  = "Adipocytes",
                           "5"  = "Cytotoxic T-cells",
                           "6"  = "APCs",
                           "7"  = "B-cells",
                           "8"  = "DCs",
                           "9"  = "Macrophages",
                           "10" = "Helper T-cells",
                           "11" = "IgM B-cells",
                           "12" = "Macrophages",
                           "13" = "Neutrophils",
                           "14" = "Macrophages",
                           "15" = "Others",
                           "16" = "Others")


spe$celltype <- cluster_celltype
unique(spe$celltype)

spe$celltype <- factor(
  spe$celltype,
  levels = c(levels(spe$celltype), "Endothelial","Regulatory T-cells","M1 Macrophages","M2 Macrophages")
)

## color cell-type

celltype <- setNames(
c("#d62728",
  "#ff7f0e",
  "#ffbb78",
  "#1f77b4",
  "#6baed6",
  "#aec7e8",
  "#8c564b",
  "#C4A484",
  "#2ca02c",
  "#c5b0d5",
  "#393b79",
  "#7f7f7f",
  "#f7b6d2",
  "#FF7F7F",
  "#1f77b4"),
            
c("Macrophages",
  "M1 Macrophages",
  "M2 Macrophages",
  "Helper/Regulatory T-cells",
  "Helper T-cells",
  "Cytotoxic T-cells",
  "B-cells",
  "IgM B-cells",
  "Neutrophils",
  "DCs",
  "APCs",
  "Others",
  "Adipocytes",
  "Endothelial",
  "Regulatory T-cells"))

metadata(spe)$color_vectors$celltype <- celltype
```


#subcluster IgM B-cells
```{r,fig.height=10, fig.width=18}
# choose the parent cluster to subcluster
parent_cluster <- "IgM B-cells"

# indices of cells in that cluster
idx <- spe$celltype == parent_cluster

spe_sub <- spe[, idx]   # subset SCE to just that cluster
ncol(spe_sub)


set.seed(220621)
subclusters <- clusterCells(
  spe_sub,
  use.dimred = "fastMNN",   # reuses the fastMNN coords of these cells
  BLUSPARAM = SNNGraphParam(
    k = 150,                 # maybe smaller for fewer cells; 29 is also OK if enough cells
    cluster.fun = "louvain",
    type = "rank"
  )
)

# store subclusters back into the full SCE
spe$nn_subcluster <- NA_integer_
spe$nn_subcluster[idx] <- subclusters



spe$nn_subcluster_label <- as.character(spe$celltype)
spe$nn_subcluster_label[idx] <- paste0(parent_cluster, "_", subclusters)
spe$nn_subcluster_label <- factor(spe$nn_subcluster_label)


dittoDimPlot(spe, var = "nn_subcluster_label", reduction.use = "UMAP_mnnCorrected", size = 0.4, do.label = TRUE,labels.size = 6,legend.size = 8) 


cluster_mean <- aggregateAcrossCells(as(spe, "SingleCellExperiment"), ids = spe$nn_subcluster_label, statistics = "mean", use.assay.type = "exprs")

# Z score scaled
dittoHeatmap(cluster_mean, genes = rownames(spe)[rowData(spe)$use_channel2],
             assay = "exprs", 
             show_colnames = TRUE,
             cluster_cols = FALSE, 
             annot.by = c("nn_subcluster_label"),
             order.by = c("nn_subcluster_label"), angle_row = 45
             )


spe[,spe$nn_subcluster_label %in% c("IgM B-cells_1")]$celltype <- "Endothelial"
spe[,spe$nn_subcluster_label %in% c("IgM B-cells_2")]$celltype <- "IgM B-cells"
spe[,spe$nn_subcluster_label %in% c("IgM B-cells_3")]$celltype <- "Endothelial"
spe[,spe$nn_subcluster_label %in% c("IgM B-cells_4")]$celltype <- "IgM B-cells"
```

# Barplots
```{r,fig.height=10,fig.width=25}

dittoBarplots <- list()

for (i in unique(spe$indication)) {
  
p <- dittoBarPlot(spe[,spe$indication %in% i], 
             var = "celltype", 
             group.by = "sample_id",
             main = i) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = metadata(spe)$color_vectors$celltype)


dittoBarplots[[i]] <- p
}


dittoBarplots[[1]] + dittoBarplots[[2]] + dittoBarplots[[3]]  + plot_layout(nrow = 2, byrow = FALSE)


```

# Cell fraction per ROI
```{r,fig.height=14, fig.width=14}
# ---- helper to compute fraction per area from a SpatialExperiment ----
get_fraction_per_area <- function(spe) {

  meta <- as.data.frame(colData(spe))
  
  # area per sample_id (and indication, in case multiple indications exist)
  area_tbl <- meta %>%
    dplyr::distinct(sample_id, width_px, height_px, indication) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(area_px = width_px * height_px / 100000)
  
  # total cells per sample_id x indication
  total_cells <- meta %>% 
    dplyr::count(sample_id, indication, name = "total_cells")
  
  # cells per sample_id x celltype x indication
  counts_tbl <- meta %>%
    dplyr::count(sample_id, celltype, indication, name = "cell_count")
  
  # join all info
  counts_tbl %>%
    dplyr::left_join(total_cells, by = c("sample_id", "indication")) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(area_tbl,    by = c("sample_id", "indication")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(area_px) & area_px > 0) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      fraction         = cell_count / total_cells,
      fraction_per_area = fraction / area_px
    )
}

# ---- compute for all indications at once ----
fraction_area_data <- get_fraction_per_area(spe)

# optional: set factor order for plotting
fraction_area_data$indication <- factor(
  fraction_area_data$indication,
  levels = c("HC", "EN", "EI")
)

# ---- Wilcoxon comparisons vs HC ----
hc_comparisons <- list(
  c("HC", "EN"),
  c("HC", "EI"),
  c("EN", "EI")
)

library(ggpubr)
# ---- plot ----
p <- ggplot(fraction_area_data, aes(x = indication, y = fraction_per_area, fill = indication)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6, size = 1.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ celltype, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Cell fraction per area by indication",
    x = "Indication",
    y = "Cell fraction (per mm²)"
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = hc_comparisons,
    method = "wilcox.test",
    exact = FALSE,           # avoid ties warning
    p.adjust.method = "BH",
    label = "p.format",
    step.increase = 0.08,
    hide.ns = TRUE
  )

p


```

# TestInteractions
```{r}
spe_list <- list(EI = spe[,spe$indication=="EI"], EN = spe[,spe$indication=="EN"], HC = spe[,spe$indication=="HC"])


run_one <- function(spe) {

  spe <- buildSpatialGraph(spe, img_id = "sample_id", type = "knn", k = 30)

  parallel.params <-   MulticoreParam(workers = min(12, parallel::detectCores()), RNGseed = 221029, progressbar = FALSE, log = FALSE)

  out <- testInteractions(spe,
                          group_by = "sample_id",
                          label = "celltype",
                          colPairName = "knn_interaction_graph",
                          BPPARAM = parallel.params
                          )

  plt <- out %>% as_tibble() %>% filter(!is.na(sigval)) %>%
    group_by(from_label, to_label) %>%
    summarize(sum_sigval = sum(sigval, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    ggplot(aes(from_label, to_label, fill = sum_sigval)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = scales::muted("blue"), mid = "white", high = scales::muted("red")) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(title = paste(unique(spe$indication), "Interactions by Cell Type"))

  list(out = out, plot = plt)
}

res <- lapply(spe_list, run_one)


saveRDS(res, here::here("data", "TestInteractions.rds"))

# show all plots
for (nm in names(res)) { message(nm); print(res[[nm]]$plot) }
```
